title: Coffee for Doe

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: What do you want? Who sent you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want? Who sent you?

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: My coffee? I didn’t order any coffee.

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: Argh! Get away from me!

nodes.text: A Black Ultra Grand coffee? A B.U.G.! They're trying to track me! Who's paying you?

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: Soluble tracking devices. Nanobots disguised as coffee granules. And those k20s you see everyone drinking from? Those are sentient. They work for MedSynge, collecting saliva samples, implanting coercion chemicals through people's fingertips--

nodes.text: You do, do you? Then why are you bringing me a coffee I didn’t order?

nodes.text: Ha! Ha Ha Ha! There are no glitches.

nodes.text: You’re sure it’s safe?

nodes.speaker: John Doe
nodes.text: NO! Throw it in the sea. Wait! Better, throw it into a trash chute! That'll keep them off my trail. Will you do that?
